name: Torteria Las Tortugas
tagline: Tortas and breakfast from a drive-thru on West Cameron Avenue.
about: Torteria Las Tortugas is a drive-thru at 1121 W Cameron Ave in Rockdale, open from 5 in the morning on weekdays.
It's listed on the City of Rockdale's Local Eats guide.
hours_source: Hours from the City of Rockdale dining guide; call ahead to confirm.
